column1: # leak-patterns.tsv (harbor#1149, D-79) - the generic patterns of the leak gate (bin/lint-leaks.sh).
# Names no real entity: real clients, companies and accounts live in the private layer's leaks.tsv and terms.tsv.
# Columns, tab-separated, one header row:  id  kind  pattern  note
#   kind  literal | word | domain | email-domain | regex | allow
#   allow  forgives one exact match of one pattern (bin/lint-leaks.sh): pattern is <pattern-id>=<exact matched text>, e.g.
#          home-path=/Users/probe/. Core file only. Placeholders only: a username no person owns; never a real name.
# A word or domain ends at any character that is not a letter or digit, so `_` and a trailing `-` end one too.
# own-user is not a row: in export mode (LEAKS_EXPORT=1) bin/lint-leaks.sh derives it from the running user's name.
# CONTRACTS/lint-leaks-baseline.txt holds the count of these; it only goes down.
